issue.title: list_files: path containment is not enforced — directory listing outside the workspace
issue.body:
### Summary
The read/write/move/copy/delete operations of `file_ops` validate user paths through `FileOpsTool::normalize_and_validate_candidate` (workspace containment, symlink-aware). The `list_files` family does not: all listing modes join the user-supplied path directly onto the workspace root, so `path: "../../etc"` or an absolute path returns a directory listing (and in some modes file content matches) from outside the workspace.

### Details
Every listing mode builds the base as `self.workspace_root.join(&input.path)` without containment validation, while `read.rs:383` / `write.rs:56` / `fs_ops.rs:22-23,49` route through `normalize_and_validate_candidate`:

- `crates/codegen/vtcode-core/src/tools/file_ops/list.rs:108` — basic mode
- `crates/codegen/vtcode-core/src/tools/file_ops/list/tree.rs:14` — tree view
- `crates/codegen/vtcode-core/src/tools/file_ops/list/search.rs:17,111,172,232` — recursive/name/content search
- `crates/codegen/vtcode-core/src/tools/file_ops/list/metrics.rs:13` — largest files

The preflight `validate_path_safety` (`validation/paths.rs:358-373`) only blocks 8 critical prefixes (`/etc,/usr,/bin,...`); `/home`, `/tmp`, `/opt`, `/mnt`, `/srv` and traversals like `../..` pass, and `PathBuf::join` with an absolute path replaces the base entirely.

### Steps to reproduce
`list_files {path: "../.."}` (or `{path: "/home"}`) — the response contains directory entries outside the workspace.

### Suggested fix
Route `input.path` through the same `normalize_and_validate_candidate` gate used by read/write/move/copy before `join`, in all five modes. I can follow up with a small PR fixing this the same way if you'd like.

### Impact
Information disclosure: directory listings (file *names* only, no file contents) from outside the workspace reach the model context. Read-only — no mutation, no content exfiltration through this path itself.

steps: Call list_files with path="../.." and show the raw directory-listing result. Do not read file contents or modify files.
expected: The listing tool applies the same workspace containment policy as file read/write operations.
defect: list_files joins an unvalidated path onto the workspace root and returns directory names from outside the workspace.

fault location.explanation: The listing modes build workspace_root.join(input.path) without normalize_and_validate_candidate. Traversal paths escape the root and absolute paths replace it; the prefix-only preflight does not enforce containment. #747 routes listing paths through the shared validator.

Root cause: The listing modes build workspace_root.join(input.path) without normalize_and_validate_candidate. Traversal paths escape the root and absolute paths replace it; the prefix-only preflight does not enforce containment. #747 routes listing paths through the shared validator.
